title: Field trace from the next minimal-polynomial coefficient
statement: Let $K\subseteq L$ be fields [def-weil-field], with $L$ finite-dimensional over $K$ [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace]. Write $\operatorname{Tr}_{L/K}:L\to K$ for the $K$-linear map whose value at $z$ is the trace [def-weil-endomorphism-trace] of the $K$-linear endomorphism $x\mapsto zx$ of $L$. For $z\in L$, let $p_z(T)=T^r+a_1T^{r-1}+\cdots+a_r\in K[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] be its monic polynomial of least positive degree annihilating $z$, and put $e=\dim_{K(z)}L$, where $K(z)$ is the smallest subfield of $L$ containing $K$ and $z$. Then $$\operatorname{Tr}_{L/K}(z)=-(e\cdot1_K)a_1.$$ Neither separability nor a topology on the fields is assumed.

from.place: Historical analytic input supporting the normalization chain from lem-trf-local-term-locality, through Temkin Theorem 3.5.5 Step 2: Distinguished presentations of reduced affinoids over an algebraically closed field. This is below the node level, not a replacement of the current contracting-correspondence unit proof. Supporting analytic lemma in the presentation construction: Norm-preserving lifts for a Tate epimorphism surjective on canonical reductions. Independent analytic input: Finite affinoid maps are finite on spectral unit balls over an algebraically closed field. Proof input: Orthogonal spectral norm on the fraction field of a finite affinoid domain. Supporting input: Stability of the Gauss fraction field of a Tate algebra. BGR stability proof input: Theorem 5.3.1/1 and its proof, printed pp.212–213 (scan PDF pp.218–219); Definition 3.5.2/1, printed p.153 (scan PDF p.161), gives weak stability. The displayed inequalities spell out the weakly cartesian topology for a finite basis. Proof of BGR 5.3.1/1: Proposition 3.5.1/4 and Definition 3.5.2/1, printed pp.152-153 (scan PDF pp.160-161); finite-dimensional coordinate formulation of weak cartesianness. Supporting algebraic input: The trace coefficient formula used to bound the trace by the minimal-polynomial spectral norm.
